chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: How Ella Fitzgerald came into Chick Webb's band
summary: Chick picked Ella from the Apollo amateur show while McRae was away with Lil Armstrong; she was in the band six months before him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: What were some of the reactions publicly -- from the public and so forth --

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Ella coming in the band? Do you recall just what -- With Chick Webb?
Ella joined the band before I got -- She was like -- Chick picked her from the amateur show on 125th Street.
I was out of town when that was all going on.

I -- remember I'm coming in from Buffalo. I left Lil. I was there on the road with Lil Armstrong. We came in that winter to play the Apollo Theater. I think that winter, here in New York with Chick, it was an amateur show going on. That's when they heard Ella.
Because when I went on the road with Lil Armstrong that -- when I came back from off that trip in '36, that's when I joined --
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
See, I stayed with Lil Armstrong up to the middle part --

You know, we came back from Minnesota -- we come back to Lexington, Kentucky; we came on down -- we came into New York, the early part of the spring we came here. Just before April -- about the end of April or something.
Chick Webb was getting ready to go on the road on a one night thing (inaudible). Lil Armstrong's band had broke up. We was on the way back in that spring.
And Chick Webb was getting ready to go out on a southern trip in April. But Ella had joined the band about that winter. She was in the band about six months before I came in (inaudible).
